;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)]]
**The [[Royal Saudi Air Defense]] intercepts a ballistic missile fired from [[Yemen]] over the [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] capital [[Riyadh]] that caused panic among residents. [[Houthis]] say they fired several [[Burkan-2]] missiles at targets in Saudi Arabia, including [[Saudi Aramco]] oil facilities. Separately, Saudi Air Defenses shoot down two Houthi-operated [[Qasef-1]] drones near the border. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-security/saudi-arabia-intercepts-missile-over-riyadh-al-arabiya-idUSKBN1HI28K (Reuters)] [http://www.middleeasteye.net/news/saudi-forces-intercept-houthi-missile-over-riyadh-reports-say-219599184 (Middle East Eye)]
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**The [[Israeli Defence Forces]] say a bomb exploded near one of their construction vehicles near the [[Israel–Gaza border|Gazan border]]. In response, the IDF launches attacks on [[Hamas]] positions within the Gaza Strip. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinians-set-off-bomb-against-idf-vehicle-near-gaza-army-retaliates/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**The [[Meir Amit Intelligence and Terrorism Information Centre]] states 80% of the deceased Palestinians, including journalist [[Yasir Murtaja]], are terrorists. [http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Report-80-percent-of-Palestinians-killed-in-Gaza-border-crisis-were-terrorists-549511 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**Tamer Abu Daqqa, a resident of [[Khan Younis]], Gaza, claims he is the man shown on an unauthorised video taken by an Israeli soldier being shot by a sniper through the border fence. Daqqa rejects Israeli claims he was a ringleader of violence and says he was assisting wounded Palestinians. [http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Palestinian-shot-by-Israeli-sniper-on-video-says-wasnt-instigating-violence-549513 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**Israeli Defence Minister [[Avigdor Liberman]] bars 110 Palestinians from entering Israel to attend a joint Israeli-Palestinian Remembrance Day ceremony in [[Tel Aviv]]. [http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Defense-Minister-bars-110-Palestinians-from-Israel-for-memorial-ceremony-549475 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Terrorism in Spain]]
**[[Spain]]'s [[Audiencia Nacional]] sentences ten [[Islamic extremism|Islamic extremists]] to between eight and twelve years in prison for a plot to launch attacks against [[Barcelona]] landmarks and behead a hostage on camera. The cell was convicted yesterday. [https://elpais.com/elpais/2018/04/11/inenglish/1523432389_300417.html (''El País'')]
*[[Crime in the United Arab Emirates#Terrorism|Terrorism in the United Arab Emirates]]
**The [[Abu Dhabi]] Federal Appeal Court jails two [[Egypt]]ians and a [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] for fifteen years each and fines them for promoting terrorist ideologies online. The court orders them deported after release, their computer equipment seized, and their [[social media]] presences deleted. [http://gulfnews.com/news/uae/crime/three-get-15-year-jail-terms-on-terror-charges-1.2204046 (''Gulf News'')]
*[[Terrorism in Canada]]
**Lawyers representing Ayanle Hassan Ali, accused of three attempted murders in a 2016 [[Toronto]] knife attack on [[Canada|Canadian]] soldiers, say he should be acquitted entirely of allegations the charges had a terrorist motive and found [[not criminally responsible]] for the underlying offences on the grounds of his [[mental health]]. [http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/ayanle-hassan-ali-accused-in-military-centre-stabbing-not-a-terrorist-defence-1.4613311 (CBC.ca)]
*[[Mexican Drug War]]
**Fourteen people are killed in 36 hours in [[Cancún]], [[Mexico]], in the worst spate of violence in the city since 2004. [http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-5604855/Fourteen-murdered-just-36-hours-Cancun.html (''The Daily Mail'')]
*The [[Mechanism for International Criminal Tribunals]] partly overturns the acquittal of [[Serbian people|Serb]] radical nationalist [[Vojislav Šešelj]] and finds him guilty of [[crimes against humanity]] during the [[Yugoslav Wars]]. He is not detained as he served more than eleven years in the court's custody, and takes to [[Twitter]] to declare himself "proud of my war crimes" and "ready to repeat them". [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-04-11/hague-court-to-review-war-crimes-acquittals-of-serb-leader-sesel (Bloomberg)] [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/un-court-quashes-acquittal-of-serb-politician-for-war-crimes-1.3458569 (''The Irish Times'')]
*[[Terrorism in Iraq]]
**[[Iraq]]i [[Prime Minister of Iraq|Prime Minister]] [[Haider al-Abadi]] attends the funeral of bodyguard Brigadier General Sherif Ismail el-Morshedy, killed in action in [[Nineveh]] against [[Saraya al-Salam]]. [https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/pm-attends-funeral-ceremony-of-top-guard-killed-in-clashes-with-shiite-militias/ (Iraqi News)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[List of shipwrecks in 2018|Shipwrecks in 2018]]
**The fire onboard [[South Korea]]n ship FV ''Don Wong 701'' in the [[Timaru|Port of Timaru]], [[New Zealand]], enters its third day. At least four vessels – MV ''Searuby'', MV ''San Granit'', MV ''Longview Logger'' and MV ''Jeppesen Maersk'' – are delayed from arriving. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/timaru-herald/news/103006066/korean-fishing-vessel-still-on-fire-in-port-of-timaru (Stuff)] [https://www.stuff.co.nz/timaru-herald/news/103006066/timaru-ship-fire-delays-other-vessels-entering-port (Stuff)]
*[[2018 Algerian Air Force Il-76 crash]]
**An [[Ilyushin Il-76]] military plane crashes shortly after take-off from [[Boufarik Airport|Boufarik Military Airport]] in [[Algeria]], killing all 257 passengers on board. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-43724941 (BBC)] [https://www.sbs.com.au/news/hundreds-killed-after-military-plane-crash-in-algeria (sbs.com)]
*[[2010 Polish Air Force Tu-154 crash]]
**[[Poland]] releases a new report on the disaster, which killed 96 including then-[[President of Poland|President]] [[Lech Kaczyński]], rejecting previous findings and claiming instead [[air traffic control]]lers in [[Smolensk]], [[Russia]], gave the jet erroneous information prior to two explosions destroying the jet in midair. [http://www.thenews.pl/1/9/Artykul/358314,Polish-presidential-plane-was-destroyed-in-air-after-blast-report (Radio Poland)]
*[[Humboldt Broncos bus crash]]
**The athletic therapist for the Humboldt Broncos, Dayna Brons, dies from injuries sustained in the crash, raising the death toll to 16. [https://www.sportsnet.ca/hockey/nhl/death-toll-humboldt-bus-crash-rises-16/ (Sportsnet.ca)]
**[[Saskatchewan]] politicians seek a redesign of the intersection where the crash occurred, which was also previously the scene of a six-death crash in 1997. [https://www.sportsnet.ca/hockey/nhl/changes-called-bus-crash-deadly-intersection/ (Sportsnet.ca)]
*The family of a man killed in [[California]] when his [[Tesla Model X]] crashed with the Autopilot engaged says they intend to sue the carmaker. His wife further says he had complained of flaws in the vehicle's behaviour and predicted his death in a collision with the barrier his car ultimately hit. [https://electrek.co/2018/04/11/tesla-driver-killed-model-x-autopilot-crash-sue-tesla/ (''Electrek'')]
*[[Disasters in Indonesia]]
**The death toll from tainted alcohol in [[Jakarta]] and [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]], reaches at least 82. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-alcohol/death-toll-from-indonesia-tainted-liquor-rises-to-82-idUSKBN1HI1LN (Reuters)]
*The death toll from a fireworks factory explosion in [[Vellore]], [[India]], rises to four. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/vellore-firecracker-unit-blast-death-toll-rises-to-four/articleshow/63716164.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*The death toll from a [[Malawi]] [[cholera]] epidemic reaches 30. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malawi-disease-cholera/malawi-cholera-death-toll-rises-to-30-after-heavy-rainfall-hits-capital-idUSKBN1HI2P5 (Reuters)]
*[[Synthetic cannabis]] containing [[rat poison]] kills three and injures over 100 across the [[United States]] according to the [[Centres for Disease Control and Prevention]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation-now/2018/04/11/fake-marijuana-likely-tainted-rat-poison-kills-3-causes-severe-bleeding-100-others/506068002/ (''USA Today'')]
;Health and environment
*[[Climate change in New Zealand]]
**[[New Zealand]] [[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] bans future offshore oil and gas exploration in New Zealand, leaving existing permits untouched. [http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&objectid=12030723&ref=NZH_Tw (''The New Zealand Herald'')]
*A survey commissioned by Water [[New Zealand]] reveals [[sanitary sewer overflow]]s increased by 379% across the nation in 2017. [http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&objectid=12031102 (''The New Zealand Herald'')]

;International relations
*[[South Korea–United States relations]]
**South Korea national security adviser [[Chung Eui-yong]] visits [[Washington, D.C.]] and meets with his U.S. counterpart [[John R. Bolton]]. [http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/news/2018/04/11/0200000000AEN20180411012653315.html (Yonhap News Agency)]
*The [[European Union]] says it is optimistic a two-year dispute with [[Poland]]'s ruling [[Law and Justice (Poland)|Law and Justice]] over proposed judicial reforms will be resolved by mid May. [[Prime Minister of Poland|Polish Prime Minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] has been engaged in talks on the issue with the [[European Commission]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-poland/eu-looks-to-resolve-very-soon-row-with-poland-over-rule-of-law-idUSKBN1HI2VF (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Stop Enabling Sex Traffickers Act]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] officially signs the anti-[[Human trafficking in the United States|human trafficking]] act into law. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/true-crime/wp/2018/04/11/trump-signs-fosta-bill-targeting-online-sex-trafficking-enables-states-and-victims-to-pursue-websites/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*Elmira Medynska, the partner of [[Russia]]n whistleblower [[Alexander Perepilichnyy]], tells his inquest at the [[Central Criminal Court (England and Wales)|Central Criminal Court]] in [[London]] he seemed nervous and had been unwell prior to his death. The inquest is attempting to determine if Perepilichnyy had been murdered. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43731909 (BBC)]
*[[South Korea]]n politician [[Ahn Hee-jung]] is indicted on accusations he repeatedly [[rape]]d his aide Kim Ji-eun, who previously accused him publicly of sexual abuse. [http://gulfnews.com/news/asia/south-korea/former-south-korean-presidential-hopeful-indicted-for-rape-1.2204081 (''Gulf News'')]
*Former [[President of Andalusia]] and ex-[[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Minister of Health]] and [[Ministry of Employment and Social Security (Spain)|Labour]] [[José Antonio Griñán]] declares before the court as a key in the [[Corruption in Spain#ERE in Andalusia|ERE corruption scandal]]. [http://www.elmundo.es/espana/2018/04/11/5acdce31e5fdea89628b45a0.html (''El Mundo'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Azerbaijani presidential election, 2018]]
**Millions of [[Azerbaijanis]] vote in the [[Elections in Azerbaijan|presidential elections]]. [[President of Azerbaijan|President]] [[Ilham Aliyev]] receives 86% of the vote and is re-elected for another seven-year term. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/polls-open-in-presidential-election-in-azerbaijan/2018/04/11/72e97678-3d5b-11e8-955b-7d2e19b79966_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[2017–18 United States political sexual scandals]]
**A special investigatory committee from the [[Missouri House of Representatives]] releases a report on Governor [[Eric Greitens]]'s alleged invasion of privacy and sexual misconduct. [http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-greitens-unwanted-sexual-encounter-20180411-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')], [http://fox2now.com/2018/04/11/house-committee-releases-greitens-report-governor-calls-report-a-witch-hunt/ (FOX2Now)]
*[[Paul Ryan]], the [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives]], announces that he will not seek re-election to his seat from [[Wisconsin's 1st congressional district]] in the [[United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections_in_Wisconsin,_2018#District_1|November mid-term election]]. Ryan has been Speaker since October 2015. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/powerpost/house-speaker-paul-ryan-will-not-seek-reelection-he-tells-friends-and-colleagues/2018/04/11/0d2719e4-3d83-11e8-8d53-eba0ed2371cc_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
